findings.description:
Reentrancy in FeeStrip.redeem(uint256,uint256,address) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#279-289):
	External calls:
	- s.claim.consume(msg.sender,amount) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#283)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- reservedUSDC -= payout (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#286)
findings.disposition: All affected external entrypoints are nonReentrant. Dependencies are code-pinned; FeeClaim.consume has no callbacks. State and reserves roll back if an external call fails. Native lifecycle and adversarial recipient tests exercise this boundary.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in FeeStrip.acceptOffer(uint256,uint256) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#197-225):
	External calls:
	- positionManager.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),o.tokenId) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#207)
	- (oldUSDC,oldOther) = _collect(o.tokenId,key) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#208)
		- positionManager.modifyLiquidities(abi.encode(actions,params),block.timestamp) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#369)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- s.tokenId = o.tokenId (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#211)
	- s.residualOwner = msg.sender (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#212)
	- s.key = key (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#213)
	- s.tickLower = info.tickLower() (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#214)
	- s.tickUpper = info.tickUpper() (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#215)
	- s.liquidity = liquidity (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#216)
	- s.activationBlock = uint64(block.number) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#217)
	- s.endBlock = o.endBlock (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#218)
	- s.baselineX128 = _clearedGrowth(key,s.tickLower,s.tickUpper,o.tokenId) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#219)
	- s.quantity = o.quantity (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#220)
	- s.claim = new FeeClaim(o.quantity,o.buyer,o.buyerQuantity,msg.sender) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#221)
	- id = nextSeriesId ++ (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#209)
findings.disposition: All affected external entrypoints are nonReentrant. Dependencies are code-pinned; FeeClaim.consume has no callbacks. State and reserves roll back if an external call fails. Native lifecycle and adversarial recipient tests exercise this boundary.

findings.description:
FeeStrip.acceptOffer(uint256,uint256) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#197-225) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- o.consumed || o.endBlock <= block.number || o.deadline < block.timestamp || o.proceeds < minProceeds (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#200)
findings.disposition: Timestamp checks only expire offers and trade orders. Sold fee income uses the frozen end-of-block number and authenticated historical state.

findings.description:
FeeStrip.fundOffer(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint64,uint64) (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#151-184) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- seller == address(0) || quantity == 0 || buyerQuantity == 0 || buyerQuantity > quantity || proceeds == 0 || endBlock <= block.number || deadline < block.timestamp (contracts/src/FeeStrip.sol#161-162)
findings.disposition: Timestamp checks only expire offers and trade orders. Sold fee income uses the frozen end-of-block number and authenticated historical state.

findings.description:
FeeStripMarket.buildOrder(uint256,address,bool,uint256,uint256,uint40,bytes32) (contracts/src/market/FeeStripMarket.sol#37-68) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,error)(maker != address(0) && claim != address(0) && claim != cash && claimUnits > 0 && usdcUnits > 0 && deadline > block.timestamp,revert InvalidOrder()()) (contracts/src/market/FeeStripMarket.sol#42-43)
findings.disposition: Timestamp checks only expire offers and trade orders. Sold fee income uses the frozen end-of-block number and authenticated historical state.
Proof verification has independent header, account, storage and endpoint bounds; removing checks for complexity would weaken verification.

findings.description: FeeStripRouter._runOpcode(Context,uint256,bytes) (contracts/src/market/FeeStripRouter.sol#15-19) is never used and should be removed
findings.disposition: The official VM invokes the overridden virtual dispatcher. Actual Aqua transfers require both extension opcodes; runtime tests demonstrate reachability.

findings.description:
Version constraint >=0.8.26<=0.8.30 is too complex.
It is used by:
	- >=0.8.26<=0.8.30 (contracts/src/FeeClaim.sol#2)
findings.disposition: FeeClaim is deliberately shared across native Uniswap0.8.26 and pinned SwapVM0.8.30 compilation graphs. Both builds and integrated transfers pass.
